data.title: SOL Bay
data.about:
Nestled in the thriving area of Business Bay, close to the lavish neighborhoods of Downtown Dubai and Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Sol Bay Business Bay offers an unparalleled living experience with its 17-story tower. 

This prime development by Sol Properties features studio, 1, and 2 bedroom apartments for sale with majestic views of the Burj Khalifa. On the ground floor, you’ll find a selection of high-end retail outlets and fine dining restaurants, with office spaces occupying the first two podium levels.

The residential units are available from floors 3 to 17, promising a range of luxurious living options. Embrace a life of comfort and convenience with Sol Bay’s fully-equipped gymnasium and extensive swimming pool. The beautifully landscaped leisure deck is ideal for relaxing evenings and social gatherings, offering stunning views of the Dubai skyline. Each apartment is meticulously designed to maximize space, light, and views, ensuring every room is bathed in natural daylight through full-height windows, integrating you into the heart of Dubai’s iconic landscape.
